text.en:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Unleashes the beast when full.

Dealing damage with Tarrabah grants Raveneous Beast <pve 2% /> <pvp [5%] /> charge for each hit. Taking damage grants it 1% charge per instance taken.

Stowing Tarrabah subtracts 50% charge (E.g. 70%🠚20%).

At full power, hold [Reload] to '<bold Unleash The Beast />' and <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine, granting the following benefits for 8 seconds:
• <pve 187% /> <pvp [120%] /> increased Bodyshot Damage
• <pve 99% /> <pvp [52.7%] /> increased Precision Damage
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [15%] /> <solar/>Solar Damage Resistance
• 20% increased Rate of Fire
• 100 Handling
• 100 Mobility
• 100 Reload Speed
• 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 33% increased Slide Distance
